docs.title: Introduction
docs.text:
Welcome to Octogon Oni's website, we aren't entirely sure why you are here but we welcome you all the same. Master Oni looks forward to you training in his gym.

  • For support PLEASE reach out to Master Oni.
  • For resources - good luck we have none because memoranda took all our time.
  • On a real note, the resources are really just click around, we did our best to ensure it was easy to use. If you can't find how to switch accounts or log out or edit information check the top right of the program.

Have a great day and good luck with your training.

docs.title: Acknowledgements
docs.text:
This website and subsequent project were developed by students at ASU. Specifically in the class SER 316 as a way to learn how to work with Git, GitHub, Legacy software, and Scrum processes. Due to Education rights information, the actual student information will be held within the private repo that is shared only among the teaching team and students.

The legacy software we utilized was memoranda from early 2000's and was provided via the school and likely a public repository.
